Chapter 6848: Ordinary Me Physique

Chapter 6848: Ordinary Me Physique

Bear Immortal saw something different - Li Qiye’s infinite and unreachable dao. It was hopeless to reach this height. Nevertheless, he still wanted to make the journey.

Anyone with a weak dao heart would feel despair. Only perseverance could move someone forward after they knew the truth. Thus, the bear immediately stabilized his dao heart, not allowing himself to fall into darkness.

“Young Noble, what is this body?” He could tell this was Li Qiye’s body.

No matter what people saw, it was a reflection of their own minds. Only Li Qiye could see his body. If one couldn’t even see Li Qiye’s true body, how could they ever harm him?

Thus, even if the bear were to use all of his power along with his master’s legacy, he would not be able to hurt Li Qiye in the slightest. He only saw himself while attempting to see Li Qiye.

Thunder Emperor, on the other hand, didn’t notice any of this.

“Ordinary Me Physique.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Ordinary Me?” The bear was surprised to hear this name.

“Ordinary...” As for the emperor, this left an indelible mark on her mind.

“You... are unqualified.” Li Qiye seemed to be standing up.

The high heaven was above all, just not Li Qiye or his supreme will. The particles taken from Thunder Emperor were immediately returned to her along with everything else.

After all, this light was only an imitation, not the high heaven.

“Boom!” He crushed and destroyed the light to the spectators’ astonishment.

Others killed emperors and immortals while Li Qiye killed the high heaven. Of course, this was just another illusion.

The sphere of water appeared before them. Nevertheless, the slaying of the high heaven was unforgettable.

Thunder Emperor became paralyzed on the ground, unable to get up. She dared to face immortals such as Bear but Li Qiye was something else.

After all, she could become an immortal in due time, given the advantages in the nine major worlds. However, she could never catch up to a being capable of slaying the high heaven.

With the illusion gone, figures could be seen within the water sphere. Their unique auras were peerless and domineering.

One could be seen clearly within the water sphere as if about to burst out. He had a refined and scholarly demeanor as though he had read countless books and poems.

“You!” He shouted upon seeing Li Qiye.

The other figures also noticed Li Qiye and rushed toward him one after another. This caused the sphere to spin wildly.

“One-page Emperor.” Li Qiye wasn’t surprised to see him.

Another figure rushed out before One-page could speak, exuding the aura of a grand emperor and an evil presence stemming from his eyes.

“Evil-eyed Emperor.” Li Qiye smiled.

A third being pushed Evil-eyed Emperor aside, looking like a devil king with an intimidating aura.

“Why aren’t you in here? How did you escape?!” He shouted.

“Tyrannical Devil King.” Li Qiye smiled again.

Just like before, another shoved him away to speak: “Weren’t you in here before?”

“Victorious Emperor.” Li Qiye sighed.
